correctness.rationale: All 65,536 masks were examined using two distinct algorithms for each r; the resulting 6813/15197/21973 admissible faces were reduced by acyclic matchings checked on every face-poset incidence. Exact signed integral Morse matrices have Smith factors all 1, yielding reduced homology Z^3 in degree 6 for r=2,3 and Z^21 in degree 7 for r=4. With no critical 1-cells or 2-cells and connected CW models, Hurewicz and the homology Whitehead theorem give the claimed wedges. Three integral source cycles were lifted to actual original simplicial cycles (support sizes 206,250,226) with boundary zero, projected into stage three and combined with stage-three seven-boundaries to form a 9×6 matrix with determinant-one top 6×6 minor. This shows the natural inclusion acts isomorphically on the full integral H6, hence is a homotopy equivalence.

value.rationale: The higher-independence filtration is a natural established topological invariant of graphs; GP(8,3) is the canonical 16-vertex cubic symmetric graph. The equal wedge types at adjacent indices alone would not determine the natural persistence map, so proving its integral unimodularity is nonroutine topological information. The next stage changes homology dimension and sphere multiplicity, giving an exact motivated homotopy plateau/jump and a computable three-stage persistence interval result.
